liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Stella Blue** (2 reviews): Stella Blue is considered one of the most emotional Grateful Dead moments ever; Stella Blue is named the best ever, bringing tears to the listener's eyes [9][10]
- **Victim Or The Crime** (1 review): The Victim, Scarlet, and Fire sequence was a crowd pleaser, rare for Jerry's birthday [6]
- **All Along The Watchtower** (1 review): The Watchtower is called the funkiest and weirdest version, highlighting Vince's keyboard work [8]
- **Liberty** (1 review): The Liberty is considered the best heard, following a nice cut of Satisfaction into it [13]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-08-01.schoeps.wklitz.96433.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 170 min; rated 2.29/5 by 7 [1]
- **gd94-08-01.neumann.nawrocki.12522.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 174 min; rated 4.45/5 by 11 [2]
- **gd1994-08-01.141177.Icmc5-mk4.IIFOB-mk4.ebel.flac1644**: source not stated; 18 songs; 175 min; rated 1/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd94-08-01.set2-sbd.georges.1026.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 11 songs; 135 min; rated 3.94/5 by 33 [4]

## Around the show

- A huge birthday card was signed on entry; the arena was ice cold and Jerry wore maroon [12]
- The Palace was the only indoor venue that summer, offering air conditioning after the western heat [15]
- The first set was weak, but the second set was outstanding for the summer tour [7]
- This was the strongest set of the last three nights and the first show on August 1 since 1982 [12]
- The reviewer believes the March 21, 1994 Stella Blue is even better than this performance [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-08-01.schoeps.wklitz.96433.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK4's>Rbox>Technics SV-MD1 [1]
- **gd94-08-01.neumann.nawrocki.12522.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Doug Nawrocki; source: Audience: Neumann TLM 170i's [2]. Also: Recorded with Neumann TLM 170i mics into a modified D10 pro II recorder; Transferred by Doug Nawrocki using a DA-P1, Audiophile 2496, and Sound Forge 6 software [2]
- **gd1994-08-01.141177.Icmc5-mk4.IIFOB-mk4.ebel.flac1644**: transferred by Pete Ebel; source: flac16/44.1 Source Info:Set #1: TS? Schoeps CMC5 Mk4->Oade P/S-> Sony D10 Pro II-> DATSet #2: FOB Schoeps MK4-> Reutelhuber P/S-> DAT (Ace Cubby)Transfer… [3]
- **gd94-08-01.set2-sbd.georges.1026.sbeok.shnf**: source: DSBD> CD> EAC [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by D.King Gallery: [Reonegro Grateful Dead 8/1/1994 Jerry's Birthday Auburn Hills MI Backstage Pass](https://www.dking-gallery.com/store/Dead_Pass_940801.html) [18]
